'''Danine Candraed''' is the [[High Seat]] of [[House Candraed]].

== Activities ==
She refuses to throw her House behind [[Elayne Trakand]] or [[Arymilla Marne]]{{ref/book|11|35}}.

== Trivia ==
Her House is the only of the nineteen great [[Andoran]] Houses the sigil of which has never been revealed.
